standalone_runtime.independence_gate: standalone src contains no resonance_world dependency or reference

world_integration.dependency_direction: Resonance World -> Resonance ContextGraph; reverse dependency forbidden

extraction_findings.repeated_delivery_semantics: Frozen W3 can emit the same provenance source_id more than once when participant and scout are the same observer. The standalone adapter preserves source_id as provenance, assigns delivery-unique claim_id values, filters confidence first, and uses last admissible same-observer predicate delivery before cross-observer canonicalization.

cg11_stopping_contract_discrepancy.historical_preregistration_prose: Stop when the six-mission selected-pair vector matches the immediately preceding checkpoint, otherwise stop at 168.
cg11_stopping_contract_discrepancy.executed_frozen_evaluator: In addition to pair stability, stopping_observables computed minimum selected-role event support and minimum selected-role score margin; choose_stop enforced support >= 0 and score margin >= 0.0. The support threshold is vacuous but the score-margin threshold is not.
cg11_stopping_contract_discrepancy.architectural_resolution: Do not rewrite CG-11 history. The standalone runtime follows the executed frozen evaluator because that implementation generated the confirmatory result, and the discrepancy is documented explicitly.

retirement_boundary.reason_not_deleted_now: Historical CG runners and replay fixtures still require the legacy modules to reproduce frozen science. Runtime ownership is retired; scientific compatibility ownership remains.
retirement_boundary.legacy_world_context_graph_modules_becom: scientific compatibility fixtures, not production runtime ownership

interpretation: Architectural graduation is complete through a stable v0.1.0 release. Resonance ContextGraph main owns the validated runtime semantics, and Resonance World resolves the integration through the immutable release tag. The release itself adds no new efficacy claim; exact CG-5/CG-11 replay remains the architectural parity proof.
